question.text: Under the SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008, what happens if the noticee does not reply to the show cause notice or fails to appear for hearing?

answer.text: The case is referred to the Supreme Court
A fresh notice must be issued and the process restarted
The designated authority may conclude proceedings ex-parte based on material available on record, after recording reasons

explanation.text: The Logic: If the noticee does not reply or fails to appear on the scheduled date, and the designated authority is satisfied that sufficient opportunity has been given, the designated authority may conclude the proceedings on the basis of material available on record after recording reasons for doing so. The Trap: Automatic dismissal would benefit the defaulter; the regulation instead allows the proceedings to continue ex-parte rather than being terminated. Issuing a fresh notice is also not required once sufficient opportunity has been given. Note: The "after recording reasons" requirement is the procedural safeguard the source emphasises.
